name: Motta di Livenza (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of red and white, the red charged with two white eight-pointed stars.
history: Municipal flag of Motta di Livenza, a comune in Veneto; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: two eight-pointed stars on the red stripe
